span.p:
perf-sentinel daemon — centralized mode
───────
mode: watch (1 daemon for the whole fleet)
window: trace_ttl_ms=30s · correlation window=10min
capacity: max_active_traces=10000 (LRU eviction)
scope: cross-service correlations available
tuning: sanitizer_aware_classification = auto/strict/always/never
(disambiguates N+1 SQL vs redundant SQL when OTel sanitizer is on)

span.p:
perf-sentinel daemon — sidecar mode
───────
mode: watch (per-pod, in same network ns)
window: trace_ttl_ms=30s · correlation window=10min
scope: pod-only (no cross-service correlations)
tuning: sanitizer_aware_classification = auto/strict/always/never
(disambiguates N+1 SQL vs redundant SQL when OTel sanitizer is on)

span.p:
perf-sentinel CLI — local dev batch
───────
mode: analyze --input / report --input / inspect / pg-stat
in: traces.json · auto-detects native OTLP-JSON / Jaeger v1 / Zipkin v2
(file exporter, daemon snapshot, or Jaeger UI export)
Runs in Docker or directly on dev machine:
macOS (ARM), Windows (ARM/AMD), Linux (ARM/AMD)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; overflow-wrap: break-word; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
perf-sentinel daemon — local dev live
───────
mode: watch on dev workstation
listens on 127.0.0.1:4317 (gRPC) / 4318 (HTTP)
window: trace_ttl_ms=30s · correlation window=10min
scope: dev's running services only
tuning: sanitizer_aware_classification (.perf-sentinel.toml)
